objective: Create one restartable, disk-bounded exact BF16 cache of the already-frozen 64 calibration and 32 internal-validation block-input and block-output rows for every Qwen3.8-27B text layer, with bit-exact reproduction of authenticated pilot layers 0, 32, and 63, so the successful mixed CQ3/AFF3 plus sensitivity-gated residual method can be expanded without another mode or hyperparameter search.

scope.layer_pattern: three linear_attention blocks followed by one full_attention block, repeated sixteen times

semantic_placement_addendum.placement: complete block output correction from complete block input

data_protocol.source: reuse the exact token IDs, attention mask, positions, calibration row ordinals, validation row ordinals, and text lists from the authenticated pilot cache
data_protocol.benchmark_contamination_forbidden: No CUTE, MATH-500, code, MMLU, WikiText, fresh-confirmation text, or generated model output enters this cache.

execution.streaming: load one exact safetensors layer into a meta-instantiated Qwen3.5 decoder block, propagate the full hidden state, retain only the frozen selected rows, then release the layer
execution.checkpoint_contents: next layer, exact full BF16 hidden state, selected rows completed so far, and per-layer execution receipts
execution.resume: a checkpoint is accepted only when model, revision, preregistration hash, parent-cache hash, layer prefix, shapes, dtypes, and finiteness all match
execution.allocator_control: run garbage collection and libc malloc_trim after every streamed layer
execution.completion_order: atomically save final cache, then terminal receipt, then completion marker; only then remove the superseded rolling checkpoint

promotion_rules: run the frozen all-layer stream and accept only a complete cache with all 64 contiguous layer records
any source, row, layer-pattern, shape, dtype, finite-value, pilot-parity, cache-size, or checkpoint identity failure is terminal or infrastructure-invalid as classified by the runner
pilot layers 0, 32, and 63 must reproduce the old selected inputs and outputs bit-for-bit
a pass admits one all-layer mixed CQ3/AFF3 training preregistration using the already-frozen mode map and hyperparameters
the cache is not a quantized model, quality result, runtime result, or scientific breakthrough
fresh confirmation remains sealed until a complete all-layer candidate and its sensitivity-selected residual payloads are frozen
next_if_passed: Preregister one restartable 64-layer expansion of the already-frozen CQ3 MLP and AFF3 attention-output training, then apply the unchanged validation-error sensitivity rule and rank-16 residual only to admitted layers before opening a new untouched all-layer confirmation set.
claim_boundary: A pass proves only that exact frozen calibration and internal-validation block rows for all 64 Qwen3.8-27B text layers were streamed and cached with authenticated pilot parity under bounded CPU resources. It does not establish approximation quality, a complete model, end-to-end capability or speed, novelty, or a scientific breakthrough.
